cli.usage:
Usage: npm run bench -- [--port 4477] [--profile <dir>] [--connector <binary> | --no-connector] [--reset]

Starts a fake Sidevoice Core (protocol v3) on a private profile, runs the Rust connector built in
packages/connector-rust/target against it, and serves a web UI on 127.0.0.1.
cli.connectorMissing: No connector binary found. Build it: (cd packages/connector-rust && cargo build --release), or pass --connector <path>.
cli.harnesses: Point an agent at it (only the bench profile is written):
